programs.title: Khubsoorat
programs.desc: The lady of a household runs the place with utmost strictness but hilarity and chaos ensues when her daughter-in-law's younger sister pays a visit and tries to change the rules in the house.

programs.title: Diwana
programs.desc: Pyarelal, a lovable orphan, is taken in by a Muslim lady. When he gets arrested for murder, no one believes it, but to everyone's shock he admits that he is guilty.

programs.title: The Burning Train
programs.desc: An engineer's dream of making the perfect train for Indian Railways is given hope when the company commissions his prototype. After years dedicating himself to his dream, his family has suffered, but now he hopes to make it all up to them with the train's triumphant inaugural journey. However, an embittered fellow employee has other ideas.
